title: File Input
lead: Get started with the file input component to let the user to upload one or more files from their device storage based on multiple styles and sizes

prose.text:
The `<FileInput>` component can be used to upload one or more files from the device storage of the user available in multiple sizes, styles, and variants and built with the utility-first classes from Tailwind CSS including support for dark mode.

Make sure that you have included Flowbite as a plugin inside your Tailwind CSS project to apply all the necessary styles for the `<FileInput>` component.

To start using the component make sure that you have imported it from Flowbite React:

prose.title: File upload example
prose.text: Get started with a simple `<FileInput>` component to let users upload one single file.

prose.title: Helper text
prose.text: Add a descriptive helper text to inform users the allowed extensions and sizes of the files.

prose.title: Multiple files
prose.text: Apply the multiple attribute to the `<FileInput>` component to allow more files to be uploaded.

prose.title: Sizes
prose.text: Choose from the small, default, and large `<FileInput>` sizing options.

prose.title: Dropzone
prose.text: The dropzone `<FileInput>` component can be used to upload one or more files by clicking anywhere in the area.

prose.title: Theme
prose.text: To learn more about how to customize the appearance of components, please see the [Theme docs](/docs/customize/theme).
